name: test-click-counter
description: [test] Inject a button that increments a data-attr counter on each click; click 3 times; assert counter is 3. Uses addEventListener (CSP-safe — works on pages with strict-script-src CSPs).

actions.expression: (() => { document.body.innerHTML = ''; const b = document.createElement('button'); b.id = 'btn'; b.textContent = 'click'; b.dataset.n = '0'; b.addEventListener('click', () => { b.dataset.n = String(parseInt(b.dataset.n) + 1); }); document.body.appendChild(b); })()
